item.text: [{"task_id":"db7260a4","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    bg = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    water = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    wall = int(round(params['colors'][2]))","    step = int(round(params['motion'][0]))","    direction = int(round(params['motion'][1]))","    out = grid.copy()","    drops = np.argwhere(grid == water)","    if step != 1 or direction != 1 or len(drops) == 0:","        return out","    out[grid == water] = bg","    h, w = grid.shape","    for drop in drops:","        r = int(drop[0]) + step","        x = int(drop[1])","        caught = False","        while r < h:","            lefts = [c for c in range(x) if grid[r, c] == wall]","            rights = [c for c in range(x + step, w) if grid[r, c] == wall]","            if len(lefts) == 0 or len(rights) == 0:","                r += step","                continue","            left = max(lefts)","            right = min(rights)","            bottom = r","            while bottom + step < h and grid[bottom + step, left] == wall and grid[bottom + step, right] == wall:","                bottom += step","            if bottom == r:","                r += step","                continue","            gaps = [c for c in range(left + step, right) if grid[bottom, c] != wall]","            if len(gaps) == 0:","                for rr in range(r, bottom):","                    for cc in range(left + step, right):","                        if grid[rr, cc] == bg:","                            out[rr, cc] = water","                caught = True","                break","            x = gaps[0]","            r = bottom + step","        if not caught:","            out[h - step, :] = water","    return out"],"shapes":{"colors":[3],"motion":[2]},"params":{"colors":[0,1,2],"motion":[1,1]},"rationale":"The blue drop falls into red cups. A sealed cup fills its interior; a cup with a floor gap drains through that gap into any cup below. If no cup catches the water, it fills the bottom row. The test's upper cup drains through column 6 into the sealed lower cup."}]
